reviews.head: af51c7395267128d8ef71e506696b29c6cde8329
reviews.report: 1. [blocker] commands.py:1028-1033, 1234-1237 and tick.py:136-139: merge_now runs pr_pending before gate_refusal. On a gated PR with pending GitHub checks, accept sets auto_merge=checks and exits 0 despite failed local checks, missing rounds, out-of-repo links, or stale base, and tick_store drops GATE_REFUSED without setting attention (stuck in Merging). Run gate_refusal first, return GATE_REFUSED for gated pr_pending, and set attention in tick_store. 2. [blocker] commands.py:1055-1068: gated cmd_merge skips state==ready and busy_again, merging a running task at an earlier passed sha1 mid-work (or passing empty sha when head is unset and falsely sending MOVED). Enforce state==ready and busy_again in gated cmd_merge. 3. [blocker] commands.py:1030-1034, github.py:247-252: gated merge_now omits branch_tip(s, t) != sha. If a worker commits sha2 locally after ready at sha1, merge_now merges sha1 and finish runs git branch -D, deleting sha2. Refuse when branch_tip != sha in gated merge_now too. 4. [major] checks.py:69-86: checks_pass clears GATE_REFUSED attention only on local check_run completion, not when PR CI updates to success or ages past CI_WINDOW_MS, leaving real view() stuck in status=needs. Clear GATE_REFUSED attention in lines 82-86 too. 5. [major] commands.py:1142-1147, 1166-1171: PR gate runs unchecked git fetch without timeout or refspec (fetch failure falsely triggers MOVED), gate_refusal says rebase onto local base instead of remote/base, and writes bare herdr-task ready (blocked by launch.py allow rules) plus commit. Use git_quick with refspec, remote/base for PRs, and own_path() ready s.ref(t). 6. [major] commands.py:1120-1130: gate(s, t, sha) with review.min==0 raises IndexError at counted[-1] instead of [] per contracts/gate-evidence.md:45. Return [] when not need. 7. [minor] commands.py:1227, 1254: cmd_accept leaves accepted_at set on refusal.

reviews.head: 608709a764162b625d7eca8002b6bd1ce77f6c0d
reviews.report:
1. [major] mods/tasks/bin/herdr_task/tick.py:136-148, checks.py:82-87: Auto-merge PRs waiting on gate checks/CI flip to Needs you, and "none" CI refusal sticks past CI_WINDOW_MS. In tick_store, merge_now (138) runs before checks_pass (147) and sets t["attention"]=err (142); task_status (agents.py:102) and core/tasks.js:120 check attention before auto_merge, so TickAutoMerge (test_herdr_task.py:2230) yields ("needs","attention",...) instead of "merging" (and sends needs-you news). In no-CI repos (state=="none"), ci!=mine[-1]["ci"] is never True, so checks_pass never pops attention after CI_WINDOW_MS. Fix: run checks_pass before facts/merge_now; skip setting attention in tick.py:141-142 while checks run or CI is pending/unstarted; in checks.py:82-87 pop GATE_REFUSED attention once not last["exit"], state=="none", and CI_WINDOW_MS elapsed.

2. [major] mods/tasks/bin/herdr_task/commands.py:1024-1031, 1260: merge_now runs pr_problem(v) before gate_refusal, so when origin/<base> moves with conflicts (mergeable=="CONFLICTING"), pr_problem returns at 1025 before gate_refusal (1029): stays Ready without rebase prompt, and cmd_accept (1260) leaves accepted_at set. Fix: when gated, check only state=="CLOSED" before gate_refusal and run pr_problem after; pop accepted_at on any error in cmd_accept.

3. [major] mods/tasks/bin/herdr_task/commands.py:1053-1074, 1125, 1198: cmd_merge lacks cmd_accept:1214 busy_again check (so finish(..., even_if_busy=True) deletes a working agent worktree/branch), and gate (1125) checks only branch_tip != sha, merging over dirty tracked files or detached HEAD in t["worktree"] (unlike gate_verdict:780). Fix: check busy_again in cmd_merge, and in gate refuse if worktree HEAD != sha or git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no is non-empty.

4. [minor] mods/tasks/bin/herdr_task/commands.py:1120, test/test_herdr_task.py:1945-2205: gate(s, t, None) raises TypeError at sha[:7] (use (sha or "")[:7]); add GateMerge tests for last round changes/must_fix>0,

reviews.head: 88ded9a3c543b9e306a84236ac4551327470441d
reviews.report:
1. [major] mods/tasks/bin/herdr_task/commands.py:1024-1031, 1260-1261: merge_now runs pr_problem(v) before gate_refusal. When a gated PR base moves and conflicts (state=OPEN, mergeable=CONFLICTING), line 1027 returns before gate_refusal runs. Proof: in GateMerge run self.pr(), self.passed(), advance main, set state["v"]["mergeable"]="CONFLICTING", call self.accept() -> gate() is skipped, self.told gets no rebase message, state stays ready, and accepted_at stays set (line 1260 only pops on GATE_REFUSED). Failing rollup checks likewise skip gate_refusal. Fix: when gated and state != CLOSED, run gate_refusal before pr_problem; pop accepted_at on any error.
2. [major] mods/tasks/bin/herdr_task/commands.py:1072-1073, 1180-1184: On MOVED via cmd_merge or tick_store (tick.py:138), gate_refusal leaves prior GATE_REFUSED attention set and handed_at unset. With progress.by=herdr, on_it() is False while the worker starts/rests, so task_status and core/tasks.js show the running task as Needs you instead of Working. If tell() raises Fail in tick_store, auto_merge stays set and attention unset, retrying silently every PR_EVERY. Proof: before self.check(), call self.accept(merge=True), advance main, call self.accept(merge=True) -> state is running but task_status(task, []) is needs/attention. Fix: in gate_refusal pop GATE_REFUSED attention and set handed_at=now() on tell() ok; on Fail pop auto_merge and set attention.
3. [minor] mods/tasks/bin/herdr_task/checks.py:82-87: With ci.state==none, an early accept sets CI-not-started GATE_REFUSED attention, which checks_pass never clears once CI_WINDOW_MS elapses. Pop it once now() - last["finished_at"] >= CI_WINDOW_MS.
4. [minor] mods/tasks/bin/herdr_task/commands.py:1120, 1179: Line 1120 slices sha[:7] before checking not need / not sha (TypeError on gate(s, t, None)); use (sha or "")[:7]. Line 1179 passes None instead of args to tell(), ignoring accept/merge --space/--agent/--argv.

reviews.head: 5465aaba4cf25fdcfdad263841b97f7cc53d59c2
reviews.report:
1. [major] commands.py:1151 — git(main, "fetch", remote, base, timeout=60): (a) base.git() leaves TimeoutExpired uncaught, crashing accept/merge and cmd_tick (tick.py:138/470 catch only Fail); (b) in a --single-branch clone, git fetch without a refspec exits 0 without updating refs/remotes/<remote>/<base>, passing a stale base ref through merge-base or failing on a missing ref. Reuse launch.git_quick(main, "fetch", "--quiet", "--no-tags", remote, f"+refs/heads/{base}:refs/remotes/{remote}/{base}", timeout=60)[0].
2. [major] commands.py:1185-1187, agents.py:515-516, test_herdr_task.py:2112-2124 — gate_refusal sets handed_at and pops attention, so task_status never calls on_it(), while agents.starting() ignores handed_at. The test passed only because review_runs[-1]["at"] was <90s old; aging started and review_runs[*]["at"] by 120s makes task_status return "needs". Line 1186 also leaves PR conflict attention on t in cmd_merge. Add task.get("handed_at") to agents.starting(), pop "attention" unconditionally in gate_refusal, and age timestamps in the test.
3. [major] commands.py:1145 — ci == "none" from c["finished_at"] passes gate() after CI_WINDOW_MS without re-querying ci_of(t, sha) (if no tick ran or machine slept, checks.py:82 never refreshes it either). Repro: pr(ci="none"), passed(), set self.ci = "failure", accept at finished_at + CI_WINDOW_MS passes gate(). Re-read checks.ci_of(t, sha) when ci == "none" past CI_WINDOW_MS.
4. [major] commands.py:1061-1068 — cmd_merge skips busy_again(), so a worker mid-turn with untracked files in wt before back_pass gets its old head merged and wt removed by finish(even_if_busy=True). Check busy_again() in cmd_merge as cmd_accept:1217 does.
5. [minor] commands.py:1121 — sha[:7] before checking not sha raises TypeError on gate(s, t, None); use (sha or "")[:7].

reviews.head: e7959c39ebf5008022682cd0ff627fc0183ecd12
reviews.report:
1. [blocker] mods/tasks/bin/herdr_task/commands.py:459,434,807,1190-1192 — Moved-base rebase exhausts review_rounds so the rebased head cannot finish review.
Proof: sed -n "458,462p" commands.py checks len(runs)>=rounds where default rounds=max(rounds_cfg or 3,gate)=3 (settings.py:405). After passing sha1 (len(review_runs)=2 for min=2, 3 for min=3), gate_refusal (1189-1192) sends the task to rebase without resetting used rounds (test_herdr_task.py:2069-2078 stops before rebase). On rebased sha2: for min=3, ready hits 3>=3 and starts 0 reviewers; for min=2, ready starts round 3 (len=3), and when it passes, gate_verdict (792)->gate_step hits 3>=3, sets review_out, starts no round 4, and stalls in running.
Fix: In gate_refusal set t["rebased_runs"]=len(t.get("review_runs") or []) and pop "review_rounds_added" (pop both on reopen at 807); in rounds_used (434) subtract int(t.get("rebased_runs") or 0); in gate_step (459) check rounds_used(t, True)>=rounds.

2. [major] mods/tasks/bin/herdr_task/commands.py:466,471 — After rebasing onto a moved base, gate_step diffs {t["start"]}..{head}, including other tasks commits on base in the reviewer diff.
Proof: git diff --stat d6722e06..kc-factory already shows 2 files/19 insertions on kc-factory since start; t["start"] is never updated after launch.py:641, so git diff <start>..<rebased_head> includes every commit landed on base since start.
Fix: Compute base = f"{remote_of(s.loc[\"folder\"])}/{t.get(\"base\") or \"main\"}" if t.get("pr") else (t.get("base") or "main") and since = git(wt, "merge-base", base, head)[1] or t["start"], then diff {since}..{head}.

3. [major] mods/tasks/bin/herdr_task/commands.py:1147-1152 — gate() neither refreshes ci_of when c["ci"] is failure/pending/None nor saves c["ci"] on a late none re-read.
Proof: checks_pass (checks.py:82) stops polling once state=="failure" or "none" past CI_WINDOW_MS, and gate() (1149-1150) only calls ci_of on late "none" without saving: (a) a re-run green GitHub CI after "fa
